      Non-working days for cycle time

      Cycle time counts working days from plan start to plan finish, counting both days. Sundays and the public holidays below are excluded. When a holiday falls on a Sunday, the Monday after is excluded too. 2026 and 2027 come from MOM. Add later years here when MOM announces them, one per line as YYYY-MM-DD Name.
